question: When Priscilla barged into the daisukiyaki party, how did Al feel looking at the daisukiyaki? Was he looking around for that white something?
answer: He’s eaten daisukiyaki before, most likely. It’s really not the first time he’d seen it. (Note: daisukiyaki seems to be a food of some sort in the Re: Zero setting; maybe similar to the Japanese food okonomiyaki.)
